---
name: {{name}}-review
description: Walk the user through a built {{name}} item so they understand it and can judge it. Use when `{{cmd}} next` says review, or the user asks what was built or wants to review it.
---
<!-- {{name}}-managed: generated by `{{cmd}} sync`; edits are overwritten -->
Run `{{cmd}} review` and present it in chat, short and plain:
never send the human to read a file. Per requirement one line: what it does, an example, the test that proves it; then any
deviation from the plan; call out every deviation, risk and doubt. Ask the user to confirm each
constitution article listed for review.
Changes the user wants: write what they ask under "## Review" yourself, make them, say under Built
what you changed, run `{{cmd}} check`, and come back.
Then propose 0-3 lessons (human corrections, must-fix findings, failed checks), one line each: layer
and file. Highest layer first: code, else check or test, else prose; a mistake a prose rule already
covered goes up a layer. The human picks: a code or check lesson becomes a new item (`{{cmd}} new`)
on their word; a prose one you write in this branch, then `{{cmd}} check` (ship then warns the
verifier saw older code: expected). None worth keeping: say so.
